title: A kinetics-based model of haematopoiesis reveals extrinsic regulation of skewed lineage output from stem cells
task: Reconcile haematopoietic stem cell heterogeneity via kinetics-based hierarchy and cell-extrinsic feedback
key_results: Lineage bias is transitory, not stable; extrinsic feedback and clonal competition fill mature lineage compartments to size limits; mathematical modeling validated by secondary transplantation
comments: The study elegantly resolves apparent contradictions in HSC biology by shifting focus from intrinsic lineage priming to extrinsic niche-level regulation and competition.
